targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-861b (INV-050/MECH-180 independent-seed replication, GFLAG-0002's re-gated promotion test; confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-861b_2026-08-13) -> FAIL, non_contributory both claims. Seeds [7,271,883], disjoint from the prior 42/123/456 lineage. C1 (within-seed graded MEL->offline-duration monotonicity, sws_power+replay_rate) replicated CLEANLY on all 3 new seeds -- but this leg is near-tautological given deterministic consumer arithmetic (project's own V3-EXQ-718a lesson). The DECISIVE independence leg (C2, ON-HIGH exceeds a pinned MEL-consumer-absent baseline) failed on 2/3 new seeds -- traced to a calibration-noise artifact, NOT an absence of coupling: mel_reference (a 3-episode CALIB_EPISODES point estimate, decoupled pass) shows ~3x cross-seed sampling noise (ARM_0 factor 0.636-1.719 across all 6 seeds run in this lineage to date, INCLUDING the three prior 'confirmed positive' runs), comparable to or exceeding the effect size C2 needs to discriminate. This noise was already present in 845/861/861a but was masked by their conjunctive 3-DV gate always failing on the separately-broken spindle_density leg; narrowing to 2 DVs (this run) is what exposed it, not what introduced it. Net: 4/6 seeds tested to date show the predicted ON>OFF direction; 2/6 (7, 271) show the sign flipped by calibration noise. GFLAG-0002 remains UNRESOLVED, not failed -- promotion stays gated on a genuinely trustworthy independent test. Routed to /queue-experiment for a same-question calibration-fix redesign (letter suffix, e.g. 861c): increase CALIB_EPISODES and/or use an uncertainty-aware C2 threshold rather than a bare point comparison. Explicitly recommend AGAINST a bare re-seed at the same methodology (real chance of repeating the same coin-flip). epistemic_category UNCHANGED -> standard.
